reason_no_score_change: These are newly tracked capability donors. No benchmark point moves until the corresponding 8x8 parity gate is implemented and independently evidenced in the benchmark denominator.

donors.evidence_summary: Google's current agents-cli documentation states that Python ADK agents can serve A2A agent-card and JSON-RPC routes automatically; ADK's session service defines Session/Event creation, retrieval, listing, deletion and event append behavior.
donors.single_extra_feature: A2A-facing agent serving combined with an explicit session/event service contract.
donors.8x8_parity_gate: Expose a bounded One-Fabric agent through a typed A2A adapter whose Agent Card, session/context identity, task lifecycle and event stream are bound to PCEF authority and receipt lineage; prove cross-framework interop without creating a second task bus.

donors.evidence_summary: A2A standardizes discoverable Agent Cards, stateful Tasks, Messages, Artifacts, context IDs, streaming task updates, push notifications and standard web authentication boundaries.
donors.single_extra_feature: A framework-neutral discovery and stateful remote-task protocol with explicit artifact and streaming semantics.
donors.8x8_parity_gate: Implement an evidence-bounded A2A compatibility edge over existing One-Fabric/PCEF missions, including Agent Card authority declarations, terminal-state rules, artifact receipt binding, reconnect/resubscribe behavior and denial of authority escalation.

donors.evidence_summary: AgentFile is an open serialization format for stateful agents that packages system prompts, editable memory, tools and model settings for transfer, checkpointing and version control.
donors.single_extra_feature: Portable serialization of a stateful agent's memory, behavior, tools and model configuration.
donors.8x8_parity_gate: Define a versioned 8x8 Agent State Capsule that can export/import a deliberately scoped agent state with provenance, authority classification, secret redaction, memory freshness and deterministic round-trip tests across two clean runtimes.

donors.evidence_summary: Mastra documents workflow snapshots for pause/resume and a Temporal integration that adds durable execution, retries and richer workflow observability.
donors.single_extra_feature: A workflow abstraction that can retain Mastra ergonomics while delegating crash durability to Temporal.
donors.8x8_parity_gate: Prove a real One-Fabric mission survives worker termination from its last committed PCEF checkpoint with correlated traces/metrics showing retry, recovery latency, duplicate suppression and final receipt lineage.

donors.evidence_summary: Pydantic Evals supports serializing typed evaluation datasets to YAML or JSON, generating schemas and preserving custom evaluator definitions for version-controlled reproducible evaluation.
donors.single_extra_feature: Schema-backed, versionable typed evaluation datasets with serializable custom evaluators.
donors.8x8_parity_gate: Publish a versioned machine-readable 8x8 acceptance corpus for PCEF, handoffs, memory freshness, public/private truth and recovery canaries; reproduce the same results from a clean checkout and preserve evaluator/version provenance in receipts.
